approach: Static recompilation of the original binary, presented by the RT64 renderer.
notes: Windows 10 or later x64 with Direct3D 12, Linux x64 or ARM64 with Vulkan (ARM64 binaries are built on Ubuntu 24.04; see linux-build-info.txt for measured glibc requirements), and Android 9 or later ARM64 are release targets; the port is pre-1.0 and under active development. There is no macOS support in this branch. Both the North American USA release and Japanese Rev A are supported, each with its own saves; original Japanese Rev 0 is not. Release builds require both dumps. The recorded SHA-1 is for the 8 MiB big-endian USA .z64 dump; a byte-swapped .n64 or .v64 copy of the same cartridge hashes differently. The Japanese Rev A entry carries no SHA-1 because this repository identifies that release by its normalized XXH3-64 value instead.
